title: Two-Party Economic Mechanism
takeaways: Buyer needs supply certainty to operate mills
Seller needs price protection against harvest glut
Bilateral forward carries counterparty default risk

left.obligation: Supply Obligation: Must purchase 5,000 bushels at harvest delivery.
left.motivation: Economic Motivation: Lock in input costs against forward grain sales.

right.obligation: Harvest Obligation: Deliver 5,000 bushels of grade 2 corn in Chicago.
right.motivation: Price Protection: Eliminate downside risk from autumn price crashes.

contractConduit.title: Central Contract Conduit
contractConduit.specs: Forward Committal: 5,000 Bushels @ $4.00/bu, Sept Chicago Delivery

causalFailure.title: Causal Failure Breakdown
causalFailure.breakdown: Bilateral counterparty default risk without a centralized clearinghouse.

caption: The forward committal locks price and quantity, but leaves both parties exposed to counterparty default.
